text:
maria: FYI — quick sync today 4pm PT to align NV/AMD/Intel timelines for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi across marketplace and SI rollouts. Main asks: firmware freeze windows, press embargo slots, and lab power headroom.

juan: sending calendar invite now. can we lock the agenda? short list: 1) firmware/driver gating 2) canary images + test harness 3) regional power constraints 4) marketplace SKU/metadata mapping

simon: adding perf team to call for thermal derate discussion. we found a ~12% perf hit on long-seq H200 runs at 90% power limit. worth flagging to partners. :warning:

alisa: obs. lab capacity: east-coast test cluster is booked next week. we can carve 48h window on wed-thu if partners provide canary images by monday EOD.

ryan: from GTM — press embargo windows must be finalized before marketplace listing. need partner PR leads on the call so we don't double-book.

maria: vendor-bot, do we have driver rollout tags for the H200 images from the partner CI?

vendor-bot: H200 driver tags available: h200-driver-v2.1.3, h200-fw-2024-03-18. Canary image: rwinf/h200/canary:v20240320.

juan: nice. can we run a smoke matrix across these SKUs? Simon, can perf team add a short checklist we can share?

simon: checklist draft pasted below. I'll finalize before the call.

```
Smoke checklist (quick):
- boot + nvlink health
- driver load + cuda/cu/rocm sanity
- 1-node single-stream latency test (short seq)
- 8-node long-seq throughput run (power profile)
- KV cache correctness (GPT-3 style prompt replay)
- thermal throttling trace capture
```

alisa: adding power/thermal trace capture is key. ask partners to enable vendor counters and provide sampling at 100ms.

maria: marketplace metadata note: we need SKU tags (h100/h200/b200/mi300/gaudi), recommended quantization profiles, and supported max-seq. Ryan, we need the marketplace taxonomy aligned before listings go live.

ryan: will sync with product marketing. want a short window matrix in the thread we can hand to partners. maria, can you draft one?

maria: quick draft below — partners please confirm availability.

```
Proposed rollout matrix:
- H100/B200: canary images -> lab smoke (Mar 25-26) -> partner driver freeze Mar 27 -> marketplace preview Apr 3 -> public listing Apr 10
- H200: canary images -> lab smoke (Mar 27-28) -> partner driver freeze Mar 30 -> marketplace preview Apr 7 -> public listing Apr 15 (regional stagger: EU week Apr 8)
- MI300/Gaudi: canary images -> extended perf validation Apr 1-5 -> driver freeze Apr 6 -> preview Apr 12 -> listing Apr 20
```

simon: proposed H200 dates look tight given the thermal work. can we add a fallback: if performance regresses >8% we fallback to B200-compatible variant for preview?

maria: +1 on fallback. we'll publish a compatible-model fallback policy in the marketplace entry.

juan: action items before call: 1) vendors confirm firmware tags (vendor leads) 2) perf team run baseline on canary (simon) 3) lab carve (alisa) 4) PR & marketplace taxonomy finalize (ryan) 5) draft fallback policy (maria)

vendor-bot: reminder: calendar invite sent. conference link: https://meet.redwood.ai/partners/1707523456.

ryan: tagging @press-leads — please don't book Apr 10/15/20 for other announcements until partners confirm.

maria: thx everyone. if partners can reply in-thread with "ACK + firmware tag" that helps. i'll take notes and post action items after the call. :thumbsup:
